name: Volley Fire [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You have trained to work in ranks of archers to rain arrows down upon your foes.

Prerequisite(s): Point-Blank Shot.

Benefit(s): You grant a +1 bonus on ranged attack rolls to each ally who makes a ranged attack against a target within 15 feet of your target before the start of your next turn, to a maximum of +4. These allies don’t provide cover against your attacks.
